verdict.rationale: The security FAQ documents a self-serve Zero Data Retention toggle, set per team in Team Settings. With it on, prompts and outputs are never persisted to disk, and each response carries an `x-zero-data-retention` header that confirms the setting. This is an opt-out from content retention, not from telemetry or usage tracking in general. Missing for 10: any documented opt-out of telemetry or usage/analytics tracking itself, clarity on what metadata is still collected under ZDR, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
